title: Tachyon configuration (tachyon.yml)
description: Declares agents, terminals, commands, and settings Tachyon orchestrates in this workspace. An empty roster (no agents/terminals) is valid (t-f67185).

agents.description: Agents (AI CLIs, dev servers, watchers — any command) keyed by name. May be empty or omitted.

cmd.description: Shell command that runs the agent.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the agent's session. For Pi runtime commands, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR are Tachyon-owned private-home boundaries and must not be set here.

autostart.description: Start this agent when Tachyon starts.

watch.description: Glob(s) — restart the agent when a matching file changes.

restart.description: Crash policy: on-crash auto-restarts when the process dies with a non-zero exit (backoff 2s/4s/8s, max 3 per minute). Clean exits (0) never auto-restart.

attention.description: Needs-you detection. Defaults: on for kind=agent, off for kind=terminal. Object form tunes the idle threshold and adds prompt patterns.

silenceSec.description: Seconds of unchanged pane + idle CPU before the agent is marked idle.

patterns.description: Extra prompt regexes (case-insensitive) that mark the agent as needing input.

kind.description: agent = AI CLI (claude, codex, ...); terminal = server/shell/build. Default: inferred from cmd. Drives sidebar grouping and attention defaults.

instructions.description: Persistent operational specialization for this agent. Distinct from identity and the current execution task.

worktree.description: Run this agent in its own git worktree + branch (opt-in, off by default). This provides a separate checkout and working directory; it does not confine writes.

branch.description: Literal branch name for this agent's worktree (overrides the global settings.worktree.branch template). Validated via git check-ref-format at creation.

worktreeSetup.description: Command(s) run ONCE in the fresh worktree before the agent starts (sequential, stop-on-failure). $TACHYON_WORKSPACE_ROOT and $TACHYON_WORKTREE_ROOT are set.

harness.description: Isolated harness (spec 226/228/298/311/406): agent-scoped resources materialized into a private config home so they never leak to sibling agents. Supported: claude, codex, opencode, grok, hermes, pi (a harness on another runtime/terminal entry is a config error). Claude supports rules/skills/hooks/MCP; Codex supports instructions/skills/hooks/MCP; OpenCode/Grok/Hermes support mcp/skills/hooks (and empty harness:{} for private home + Bridge). Pi supports only workspace-local extensions/skills/prompts/themes/package directories, requires a non-empty resource list, and rejects inherit:none; its exact resource mode disables ambient Pi discovery and never fetches or installs packages. Tachyon owns runtime config-home and resource plumbing. NOTE: cross-field rules are enforced by the loadConfig validator (not expressible in pure JSON Schema).

inherit.description: Whether to seed the workspace base before overlaying. 'none' = clean slate (sees ONLY the declared config); 'workspace' = the workspace base plus declared resources. 'global' is not supported. Default: workspace. Pi resource harnesses accept only workspace (or omission), not none.

mcp.description: MCP servers scoped to THIS agent only (stdio shape). Each env value must be an exact ${VAR} reference — never a literal — so no secret is written to disk; claude expands it from the agent's process env at spawn.

hooks.description: spec 228/311 — runtime-native hooks. Claude: settings.json hooks object. Codex: hooks.<Event> config.toml object. Runtime validates the detailed event schema.

rules.description: spec 228 — Claude-only rule file path(s), concatenated into the agent's private CLAUDE.md (its own behavioral context). Workspace-relative; a single string or a non-empty list. Codex uses instructions instead.

instructions.description: spec 311 — Codex-only instruction file path(s), concatenated into the agent's private CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md. Workspace-relative; a single string or a non-empty list.

skills.description: spec 228/311/406 — skill dir path(s) (each holding a SKILL.md), copied into the agent's private home. Workspace-relative; a single string or a non-empty list.

extensions.description: spec 406 — Pi-only extension file or directory paths. Workspace-relative local paths only; a single string or non-empty list. Remote npm/git/URL sources are rejected.

prompts.description: spec 406 — Pi-only prompt-template .md file paths. Workspace-relative local paths only; a single string or non-empty list.

themes.description: spec 406 — Pi-only theme .json file paths. Workspace-relative local paths only; a single string or non-empty list.

packages.description: spec 406 — Pi-only workspace-local package directory paths. Tachyon snapshots these directories and does not fetch, install, or update npm/git packages. A single string or non-empty list.

isolate.description: Deprecated read compatibility for legacy private transcript homes. Existing isolate: transcript entries still load with a migration warning; new Claude configs should use harness: {}, while Codex is private-home by default.

subagents.description: Agents this agent declares as direct children for durable roster ownership. References must name agent entries; terminals, cycles, duplicate owners, nesting, and dangling names are rejected or dropped with warnings by the loader.

terminals.description: Terminals (servers, shells, builds) keyed by name (spec 215). May be empty or omitted. Same entry shape as an agent, but kind is always 'terminal' (so 'kind' and 'instructions' aren't meaningful here — loadConfig rejects them) and attention defaults off. The engine treats these identically to an agents: entry with kind: terminal — this block just reads more naturally.

layouts.description: Deprecated — the named-layouts feature was retired (use VS Code's native editor groups). This block is accepted for backward compatibility but ignored.

maxAgents.description: Max concurrently running agents in this workspace (fork-bomb guardrail). Overrides the tachyon.maxAgents editor setting.

bridgePort.description: Fixed port for the Bridge MCP server. Default: a stable per-workspace port derived from the workspace path (41000-42999) — registrations survive editor restarts either way.

auth.description: Require a Bearer token on every Bridge call (default true). The stable per-workspace token lives in extension storage and is injected as TACHYON_BRIDGE_TOKEN into every agent Tachyon spawns; registered configs reference the env var, so no secret lands in committable files.

legacyBridgeAuth.description: Accept the shared/legacy Bridge token as a caller identity (spec 351). Default true for existing workspaces during the per-agent-token migration window; every legacy-authenticated call is logged and cannot claim a currently-live agent's identity. Set false once every runtime you use has switched to per-agent tokens (TACHYON_AGENT_BRIDGE_TOKEN).

layout.description: Deprecated — the named-layouts feature was retired. Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored.

tmux.description: tmux server options applied to Tachyon's dedicated socket as `set -g <key> <value>`. Tachyon's defaults (mouse on, focus-events on, history-limit 10000) apply first and this overlays them; 'remain-on-exit' is reserved (crash detection depends on it). Your ~/.tmux.conf is never loaded. Values may be booleans (on/off), numbers, or strings.

base.description: Location root for worktrees; path = <base>/<wsHash>/<agent>. Default ~/.cache/tachyon/worktrees (XDG-aware).

branch.description: Global branch-name template; MUST contain {agent}. Default tachyon/{agent}.

revealInWorkspace.description: Reveal each running agent's isolated git worktree as a folder in this multi-root workspace, and remove it on cleanup (self-heals stale entries left by a prior reload). Only applies when the window is already multi-root — a single-folder window is left untouched to avoid forcing a reload.

shareDependencies.description: Compatibility kill switch for settings.worktree.sharedDirectories. Set false to disable project-declared directory sharing without removing the declaration.

sharedDirectories.description: Repo-relative literal directories to symlink from the primary checkout into separate worktrees. Only entries that exist as directories and are gitignored are admitted; invalid entries warn and are skipped. There is no product default.

bridgeGuidance.description: Append Bridge-coordination guidance to agents spawned via the Bridge so delegated work stays visible in Tachyon (spec 216). Default true.

agentHookProjection.description: Which installed plugins' hooks reach an agent's OWN session, by name (t-09edf2). Only 'enforcement' is projected, and only on gate events (PreToolUse); an unlisted plugin projects nothing. Example: { "secrets-guard": "enforcement" } makes the layer-2 --no-verify shape-gate refuse the bypass inside a delegated worktree, where the workspace .claude/.codex trees do not exist.

agentPermissionProjection.description: Opt-in permission posture projected into one named managed agent. Absence preserves the runtime/class default. Grok takes one --permission-mode word; Codex takes one key per measured door (command approval, write sandbox, Bridge MCP tool approval).

projectGuidance.description: Opt-in, project-owned agent guidance loaded from explicitly declared source-workspace files. Tachyon transports the files in order and does not discover runtime-specific context files.

files.description: Ordered, non-empty list of unique workspace-relative guidance files. Runtime validation additionally enforces UTF-8 byte, containment, file-type and aggregate-content limits.

clipboard.description: Clean clipboard copy (spec 219). 'auto' wires a UTF-8 copy-mode helper so a plain mouse drag-select (incl. scrollback) copies clean — no Shift, mouse stays on. 'off' leaves the OSC 52 default (use if copy already works or on a headless box).

taskNotifications.description: Shared defaults for VS Code task mutation notifications. Explicit user and workspace editor settings take precedence.

gitDelivery.description: RETIRED and ignored. It authorized git_delivery_integrate, git_delivery_prune and delivery_salvage, all removed with the Delivery subsystem. The key stays known so a workspace that declares it is told so by name instead of being told it misspelled something; remove it from tachyon.yml.

prunePrincipals.description: RETIRED and ignored — the pruning it authorized no longer exists.

integratePrincipals.description: RETIRED and ignored — the integration it authorized no longer exists.

companion.description: Tachyon Companion (browser / mobile shells). Human opt-in surfaces; paired device still required to execute companion operations.

allowedHosts.description: Optional host allowlist globs for Companion tab tools (e.g. example.com, *.example.com). Empty = all hosts.

tabTools.description: When true, register user_browser_* tools for agents (snapshot/screenshot/click/type/fill/eval/console). Calls fail with a clear not_paired error until Companion is paired to this engine. When false (default), tools are omitted from the tool list.

lanAccess.description: SDD 422 mobile Companion: when true, enable phone pairing via Tailscale (PC + phone on the same tailnet). Bridge binds 0.0.0.0 so the mesh can reach /companion/v1 and /companion/app; pair QR uses the Tailscale IP only (not multi-NIC Wi‑Fi). Requires the Tailscale app on both devices. Default false = loopback-only (browser Companion / same host). MCP still requires agent/bridge auth. Doctor warns when enabled without Tailscale.

ideBrowser.description: VS Code Integrated Browser (Tachyon Design Mode / ide_browser_* tools). Workspace-owned GA gate and defaults for the human surface.

enabled.description: When true, show Integrated Browser status-bar controls and allow the bridge to start. When false (default), hide the human surface and fail ide_browser_* at call time with a clear disabled error. Tools always remain registered on the Bridge when the engine wires them (MCP catalogs freeze at connect).

homeUrl.description: Default URL opened when the human clicks the IDE Browser status-bar globe (or first Design Mode open). Absolute http(s) URL, or a host (https is assumed). When unset, opens about:blank.

delivery.description: Ignored compatibility key. Canonical Delivery with mechanism-only handoff is always active; remove this block from tachyon.yml.

agentMemoryMax.description: Opt-in systemd --user MemoryMax applied to each agent's spawn tree (Linux only). A systemd size like "2G", "512M", "50%", or "off" to disable. Absent = no limit.

humanInbox.description: Control -> Inbox staleness marking (t-e4f662). Display only: nothing here approves, denies or closes anything.

staleAfterHours.description: Hours something may wait before it is MARKED stale (default 24), or "never" to stop marking for a fleet that parks work on purpose. 0 is refused: it reads as "stale on arrival", which is the opposite of the off it resembles.

agentNotifications.description: How long a parented agent may sit idle before Tachyon nudges its parent (t-585d5c). Applies on the next tick — no restart, no recreating agents.

idleAfterMinutes.description: Minutes of idleness before the parent is nudged (default 10, maximum 10080 = 7 days), or "never" to stop notifying. 0 is refused: it reads as "nudge immediately", not off.

cardTemplate.description: Agent-card layout (a 'version' plus any of the card regions). The contents are validated by the product's own card-template parser rather than by this schema, and a refused template falls back to the default card with the reason shown in Control.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the handoff document (default .tachyon/HANDOFF.md).

nudgeEvery.description: How often to nudge for a handoff update ('30m', '1h', ...), or 'off'.

persistence.description: OBSOLETE and refused by name (t-7bcba6). Silent hooks are always enabled for eligible declared Claude/Codex agents and there is no visible-legacy fallback; remove this block (including silentHooks) from tachyon.yml.

bridgeClientRebind.description: What Bridge clients do when the host generation bumps after a reload (spec 364).

onHostGenerationBump.description: 'auto' rebinds the client itself, 'notify' tells the human, 'off' does neither.

stopTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the old client to stop.

circuitFailCount.description: Consecutive failures that open the circuit.

commands.description: One-shot commands (test, lint, migrate...): run -> exit -> show result. Unlike agents/terminals, exiting is expected (exit 0 = pass). Agents can run them via the curated run_command tool.

cmd.description: Shell command; its exit code is the result.

cwd.description: Working directory (relative to workspace root or absolute).

runbooks.description: Step-by-step procedures composed of commands. Steps run sequentially in their own sessions; a non-zero exit stops the runbook (the failed pane is kept). Steps are exact command-name references or inline shell strings.

schedules.description: Recurring work: each entry fires on an interval ('every') or at a wall-clock time ('at') — exactly one — and either runs a declared command/runbook ('run') or spawns a declared agent ('spawn') — again exactly one. The 'exactly one' rules are enforced by the product with a message naming the schedule, not by this schema.

run.description: Name of a command or runbook declared in this file.

spawn.description: Name of an agent declared in this workspace.

instructions.description: Prompt handed to the spawned agent. Only valid alongside 'spawn'.

catchUp.description: Run once on startup when the window was missed while the editor was closed.
